_about: Criterion dictionary for tools/wem_lint.py — the controlled vocabulary of CODE
IDENTIFIERS the NFR lint measures src/wattleflow against (NFR-ORG-01/02/03).
JSON, not YAML: the lint is stdlib-only by design (no PyYAML dependency) and
json is the only structured format the standard library parses. Keys starting
with an underscore are prose and are dropped by the loader.
Converted from the `code:` block of documentation/dictionary.yaml on 2026-07-29
and translated to UK English. The Croatian dictionary.yaml stays the source of
truth for the DISCOURSE vocabulary (entries + acronyms) and is no longer read
by this tool.
WARNING — the discourse `acronyms` table and `identifier_acronyms` below are
NOT the same vocabulary and must not be merged: the former holds doctrine
abbreviations (DQI, NFR, PDSA, SBVR) read by people, the latter holds tokens
appearing in code identifiers (JSON, URI, SQL, OSCAL) read by the lint. Their
intersection is empty (measured 2026-07-28) and must stay empty — merging them
would make one sign carry two roles.
Versioning: `criterion_version` versions THIS criterion, `dictionary_version`
names the discourse registry revision it was cut from. They are deliberately
separate — editing an entry must not invalidate a code conformance snapshot,
nor the reverse (reproducibility triple).
Governance: every extension — a new domain, base family, acronym or TypeVar
role — requires a DR record, never an ad-hoc edit.
_python_reference: Defines the 'stdlib' set for ORG-01; must track requires-python in pyproject.toml.
_acronym_identifier_casing: Enforcement level of the acronym-casing criterion — a registry fact under DR
governance rather than a constant in the tool: `adopted` makes the check an
ERROR, any other status a WARNING.

acronym_identifier_casing.note: the lint warns (WARNING, waiver declared) instead of failing the build until the decision is taken

_blind_spots: Declared unmeasured territory (§5, column 3). Reported as INFO on every run so
the vector can never read as full coverage.
blind_spots: shared_namespace is exempt from the acyclicity and locality checks
a strategic adversary is beyond the reach of the lint
_rules: The rule table as the NFR registry declares it: id, requirement, check,
severity and waiver policy. Declared but not yet consumed by wem_lint —
severity and waiver are still decided inside each rule class.
_domains: NFR-ORG-01 — top-level functional packages under src/wattleflow. `helpers` is
the shared namespace, NOT a domain: it must not appear here, or intra-helper
imports get misreported as acyclicity breaks. `constants` is likewise absent:
it imports nothing intra-project, so it is foundation material every layer may
_scope: Clean-core filter. wattleflow-workflow is clean core: stdlib plus the libraries
listed below only (§7.1). A module importing anything outside
(stdlib ∪ wattleflow ∪ core_libraries) belongs to another distribution
(wattleflow-processors / examples) and is skipped by every rule.
`exclude_paths` opts modules out by path glob, for cases the import filter
_bases: NFR-ORG-02 — the inheritance roots of the framework; every concrete name in
the workflow package derives from one of these. Grouped by family: each family
lists its core interface(s) (I*, from wattleflow.core) and its concrete base(s)
(concrete/*). A class belongs to a family if it inherits one of that family's
_prohibited_standalone: Bare generic role nouns prohibited as standalone class names (NFR-ORG-02 criterion 6).
_identifier_acronyms: Acronym TOKENS as they appear in code identifiers — distinct from the discourse `acronyms` table (see the note above).
_type_vars: NFR-ORG-03 — a TypeVar names the SEMANTIC ROLE the type plays in the generic
contract, not the mechanism (the fact that it is a type). Acronym casing is
roles     — the closed controlled vocabulary (criterion 1). `Adaptee` is the
synonyms  — collapsed to a canonical role (criterion 6; the lint flags and suggests)
tolerated — branded names awaiting a DR decision (rename to a canonical role vs
keep): WARNING, not ERROR, until decided — the same tolerance policy
